description:
`loop.revindex` counts down to `0` instead of `1` when the loop runs over a generator and `loop.last` (or `loop.nextitem`) has been looked at earlier in the same iteration.

```python
from jinja2 import Environment


def rows():
    yield from ["a", "b", "c"]


tmpl = Environment().from_string(
    "{% for x in items %}{% if loop.last %}!{% endif %}{{ loop.revindex }} {% endfor %}"
)
print(tmpl.render(items=rows()))
print(tmpl.render(items=list(rows())))
```

```
2 1 !0 
3 2 !1 
```

The second line (a list) is right; the first (a generator) is one short everywhere: `loop.revindex0` ends at `-1`, and the value the loop reports for its size comes out as `2` for three items. Checking `loop.last` first is what triggers it — `{{ loop.revindex }}{% if loop.last %}!{% endif %}` in this order prints `3 2 1!` for the generator too, and a loop that never asks about `loop.last` or `loop.nextitem` counts down correctly. Async rendering (`enable_async=True`, an async generator or a plain one) shows the same off-by-one.

hidden_test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_repopilot_jinja_006.py b/tests/test_repopilot_jinja_006.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..687fe2d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_repopilot_jinja_006.py
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import asyncio
+
+from jinja2 import Environment
+
+
+def rows():
+    yield from ["a", "b", "c"]
+
+
+async def async_rows():
+    for row in ["a", "b", "c"]:
+        yield row
+
+
+def test_length_after_last_on_a_generator():
+    tmpl = Environment().from_string(
+        "{% for x in items %}{{ loop.last }}:{{ loop.length }} {% endfor %}"
+    )
+    assert tmpl.render(items=rows()) == "False:3 False:3 True:3 "
+    assert tmpl.render(items=list(rows())) == "False:3 False:3 True:3 "
+
+
+def test_revindex_after_nextitem_on_a_generator():
+    tmpl = Environment().from_string(
+        "{% for x in items %}{{ loop.nextitem }}/{{ loop.revindex }}/{{ loop.revindex0 }} {% endfor %}"
+    )
+    assert tmpl.render(items=rows()) == "b/3/2 c/2/1 /1/0 "
+
+
+def test_countdown_on_a_generator_ends_at_one():
+    tmpl = Environment().from_string(
+        "{% for x in items %}{% if loop.last %}!{% endif %}{{ loop.revindex }} {% endfor %}"
+    )
+    assert tmpl.render(items=rows()) == "3 2 !1 "
+    assert tmpl.render(items=iter(["a"])) == "!1 "
+    # the length is right when it is computed before any lookahead
+    tmpl = Environment().from_string(
+        "{% for x in items %}{{ loop.length }}:{{ loop.last }} {% endfor %}"
+    )
+    assert tmpl.render(items=rows()) == "3:False 3:False 3:True "
+
+
+def test_length_after_last_on_an_async_generator():
+    tmpl = Environment(enable_async=True).from_string(
+        "{% for x in items %}{{ loop.last }}:{{ loop.length }}:{{ loop.revindex }} {% endfor %}"
+    )
+    assert asyncio.run(tmpl.render_async(items=async_rows())) == "False:3:3 False:3:2 True:3:1 "
+    assert asyncio.run(tmpl.render_async(items=rows())) == "False:3:3 False:3:2 True:3:1 "
